verses: When, forthwith crossing over from that land out into Kahi, he dwelt in the palace of Sakawori, he sang, saying: "How many nights have I slept since passing Nihibari and Tsukuha?"
Then the old man, who was the lighter of the august fire, completed the august Song, and sang, saying: "Oh! having put the days in a row, there are of nights nine nights, and of days ten days!"
Therefore Yamato-take praised the old man, and forthwith bestowed on him the Rulership of the Eastern Lands.
